_A_MODAL_FORM_COLUMNS_DESCRIPTION_: The class-columns and class-column-default props are passed to the inner AForm. In this example, the name and email fields occupy half the width and stack on touch devices. The notes field defines its own classColumn and spans the full width. If these props are omitted, the defaults from AForm apply.
_A_MODAL_FORM_COMPONENT_DESCRIPTION_: AModalForm is a modal window (AModal) with a form (AForm) in the body. The form is built from data-form, the model is bound with v-model. Props with the same name work like in AModal and AForm.
_A_MODAL_FORM_DELETE_DESCRIPTION_: Besides the save and the cancel button the footer has a delete button. It is added with the slot modalFooterPrepend (before the buttons) or modalFooterAppend (after the buttons). The form has a date range, a number, a slider and a single checkbox.
_A_MODAL_FORM_ELEMENTS_DESCRIPTION_: A large modal window (size="xl") with different form elements: text, email, date, select, currency, radio buttons, checkboxes, switch and textarea. The function save shows the save button and is called when it is clicked. Three columns on the desktop, two on the tablet, one on mobile devices.
_A_MODAL_FORM_SLOTS_MODAL_BODY_APPEND_DE: A slot displayed in the body after the form.
_A_MODAL_FORM_SLOTS_MODAL_BODY_PREPEND_D: A slot displayed in the body before the text (body-html) and the form.
